description: Temporal reference selected by the executor: point 2026-01-01, derived from Article 36(2) of W. Legal status of every coded norm is recorded in_force at that reference, with validity notes by application group; Articles 32-35 recorded in_force with a note on their bounded scope.
reason: DR-04 requires a declared reference derived from the act's own provisions and the neutral metadata; the metadata give no repeal information; the sources do not fix which date to choose.
impact: Legal-status profile is reference-dependent; queued as HQ-OTHER.

description: Unit-id conventions beyond those listed in the dictionary: unnumbered subparagraphs .sub{n}; unlabelled enumeration items .pt-{k}; goods and legend tables ANX{n}.TBL{k}; unnumbered annex paragraphs .P{k}; section headings as ANX{n}.pt{x}; footnote texts inlined in the unit where the marker occurs; annex numbers/titles kept in locator text.
reason: The dictionary gives ids for paragraphs, points, annex points and recitals but not for these constructs; convention chosen to keep every part of the file addressable.
impact: Unit ids of subparagraphs, annex tables and enumerations follow the stated convention.

description: Annexes and formal provisions coded as units of W and screened/coded like operative provisions; four formula images in Annex IV and the table geometry of the Annex I and II goods tables declared as exclusions in W_DECLARATION and in the uncertainty log.
reason: GAP-01 execution decision: annexes belong to W when part of the complete frozen instrument and must satisfy the same admission rules; content not representable in the source file is declared.
impact: No record depends on the formula content; scope statements rest on the parsed table text.

description: GAP-02 examined: no provision of W amends another legal act (Article 25(5) applies Regulation (EC) No 515/97 mutatis mutandis, which is an application reference, not an amendment). No amending-provision EXT was created; GAP-02 was not used.
reason: Execution addendum GAP-02 covers provisions amending other acts.

description: Internal cross-references were followed within W to resolve counterparties, conditions and derivations; derived records state the derivation rule and cite both the source and the referenced units (many records marked 'derived'; ambiguous cross-references queued in HQ-XREF).
reason: GAP-03 execution decision: cross-references to provisions of the same frozen instrument may be followed and remain inside W.
impact: Derived QR/NA carry derivation_rule and indirect provenance links.

description: No external retrieval: every EXT is not_checked and outside_corpus_not_expanded; external instruments, national law and standards were not opened; the substance of the amended or referenced instruments is undetermined; relations whose legal constitution depends on an unresolved external reference were down-coded to 'documented' and flagged.
reason: GAP-04 execution decision: external legal retrieval prohibited during case execution.
impact: Down-coding recorded in support_gap_report/not_constituted_note; ARCH outcomes with I4 INDETERMINATE.

description: Residual function tags (authorization_designation*, cooperation_coordination*) used for assignments and relations whose function fits the residual tags; the value FUNCTION_VOCABULARY_UNRESOLVED was not needed (no legally meaningful function remained unplaced); relation types applied at the nearest of the ten types with a type note where the fit is imperfect (coordination/assistance, committee assistance, certification, protective release, legislative proposal); no new type or function category created.
reason: GAP-05 execution decision: use only the documented vocabulary and its flagged residual tags.
impact: Type notes and flags on the affected records; queued under HQ-GAP.

description: NON_OPERATIVE_SOURCE_GAP: the 'six questions' referred to in the operational template are absent from the authorized sources and were not reconstructed or used as an admission, exclusion or inference rule; the four-step anti-circularity sequence and I1-I4 were used.

Definitional provisions (Article 3, Annex IV point 1) were screened as scope/definitional-context; a defined term yields a position or device only where it bears an NA or QR elsewhere; definitions are cited as support; definitions did not establish any relation, authority, accountability or coupling by themselves.
impact: Positions such as competent authority, importer, operator, national accreditation body, customs authorities and authorised CBAM declarant cite their definition as support.

description: The mapping of the ten architectural dimensions to the families F1-F5 is not stated in the allowed sources; a provisional assignment by listing order of the dimensions was used (positional properties placed in F5); no other property names were used.
reason: The protocol states 'five families F1-F5' without listing members.
impact: property_family values are provisional; queued under HQ-GAP.

description: Epistemic down-coding: a QR or NA whose legal constitution depends on an EXT with constitutive_dependency = Y was recorded 'documented' rather than 'legal_constitution_evidenced' (RGAM-DR-19/20); the relation of the Member State to a competent authority that is only mandated (N2 designation, qr.A11_DESIG) was likewise recorded 'documented'; other relations whose party is the competent authority carry a support-gap report (an expectation, never a gate) and were not down-coded for that reason.
reason: RGAM-DR-20: an element whose legal constitution depends on an unresolved external reference is undetermined; the epistemic vocabulary has no 'undetermined' value, so the highest supported status is 'documented'.
impact: Status profile counts reflect the down-coding.

description: Subconfigurations contain NA members and PD members in addition to QR members where the organizing mechanism refers to those assignments; S whose only warrant would be shared theme (e.g., the further reports of Article 30(5)-(8)) were not formed.
reason: Dictionary lists member_na_ids and member_pd_ids; the decision rules do not say whether NAs may be members.
